meta.independence: Expectations are computed by an independent Python implementation of the documented legacy spec, reading only the raw fixed-object records exported under data/legacy/. The production GDScript LegacyDealDecoder/LegacyDealer are never invoked here.
meta.canonical_digest_format: sha256(columns ','-joined and '|'-joined + '#' + stock ids ','-joined); record 0 must equal 935879b0483480ea8f936cdc2c2b236d532d2b9531f800b19173f8dd50d620e3
